text: 🛡️ Dawn at Haven. By the fire hangs an old bark cuirass, split at the seam — somebody's grandfather wore this into the treeline and came back. The shape of it is clear: bark plates laced overlapping like shingles, vine
🛡️ The shield wall forms — strongest arms to The Eulogy, The Suburb. The small teeth can wait their turn.
🛡️ a woman, maybe 50s follows Thabo in — The Eulogy still stands.
🛡️ Oliver follows a woman, maybe 30s, with a gap-toothed grin in — The Suburb still stands.
🛡️ The shield wall forms — strongest arms to The Editor, The Eulogy, The Eater. The small teeth can wait their turn.
